name: sifa-mcp
description: MCP server for portable reputation and skills passports across Africa
author: Gabriel Mahia

tools.name: create_worker_profile
tools.description: Create a DEMONSTRATION skills and reputation profile for an informal-sector worker, with a deterministic profile ID derived from the name and phone. Use when you want to show how portable reputation could work. Records the profile in memory only: it is lost when the server restarts, nothing is verified, and the phone is masked in the output. Do not enter real people's details. Returns status, the profile_id and a profile summary. Side effect: adds a profile to the in-memory store.

tools.name: add_service_record
tools.description: Add a completed job to a worker's DEMONSTRATION profile: client, service type, duration, payment, a 1-5 rating and notes. Use when a job has been completed and you want to build the demo reputation. Records the entry in memory only; an unknown profile_id returns NOT_FOUND. Returns the updated record status and trust signals. Nothing is verified and nothing persists after a restart. Side effect: adds a service record to the in-memory profile.

tools.name: get_reputation_profile
tools.description: Show a worker's DEMONSTRATION reputation: skills, service history summary and a synthetic trust score built from job volume, average rating, verified jobs and tenure. Use when asked how a worker's track record looks. An unknown profile_id returns NOT_FOUND. Returns status and the profile with the score. The score is a heuristic on synthetic data, not a real assessment of a person. Read-only.

tools.name: generate_reference
tools.description: Generate a DEMONSTRATION reference statement for a worker from their in-memory profile, for a stated purpose. Use when a worker needs a sample reference. An unknown profile_id returns NOT_FOUND. Returns status and the reference text. Not a verified reference: nothing is checked and it should not be relied on for hiring or lending decisions. Read-only.

tools.name: list_skill_categories
tools.description: List the skill categories and example skills used for worker profiles (construction, domestic work, transport, and others). Use first, to choose valid values for a profile's primary skill. Takes no arguments. Returns status and the categories with their skills. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_workers
tools.description: Rank DEMONSTRATION worker profiles by a synthetic trust score for a required skill. Use when choosing between several profiles for a job. profile_ids lists the profiles; unknown IDs are skipped and an empty ranking has no recommendation. Returns the required skill, the ranked workers, a recommendation or null and a note that the ranking rests on synthetic scores. Not a real assessment of any person. Read-only.
